---
title: "Part 3 — Extending the composition"
---

Part 3 extends the Crossplane composition of `hello-world-pico`: additional
Managed Resources, multiple Composite Resources, and connecting the
composition to other Open Engineering artifacts (for example, wrapping a
follow-on Pico).

## Lessons

Lesson content for Part 3 follows the same lesson layout established in
[Part 1](../part-1/index.qmd) and the
[Pico Introduction lesson](../../pico/part-1/01-introduction/index.html).

::: {.callout-warning title="Scaffold — Part 3 not yet runnable"}
Part 3 is intentionally scaffolded. It is included so the Crossplane course
demonstrates a multi-part structure that other course websites can mirror,
but it does **not** yet carry runnable learner content.
:::
